jobs.title: Training Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Training Coordinator is responsible for tracking all completed hourly trainings for the plant, as well as coordinate the administrative tasks required for all training initiatives. This role involves tracking learning and program progress to ensure compliance and audit readiness. This role plays an essential part in the administration of sections of the New Hire Experience from day one through year one.


**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Coordinate training assessments and evaluations.
* Track all reports and recommendations for analyses conducted.
* Prepare procedural and training manuals, tip sheets and evaluations.
* Expedite and coordinate administrative details concerning training for overall program progress.
* Cultivate internal relationships at the operational level to gain support and participation in training.
* Define and track trainer pool by shift, position, skill set, etc.
* Assign trainers based on learning type.
* Participate in onboarding and ongoing retention programs for new employees.
* Coordinate 30\-60\-90 touch points.
* Training Communities of Practice team member. Working with other plant training teams as well as Corp training resources to define standards and best practices.
* Conform with and abide by all regulations, policies, work procedures, and instructions.
* All GLC employees are expected to perform any assignment or job task according to the stated safety policies and procedures.
* All GLC employees are expected to produce our products in a manner that exceeds the quality and value expectation of our customers and consumers by adhering to Good Manufacturing Practices, Policies and Procedures outlined in our Safe Quality Food Program.
* Other responsibilities as assigned by the manager.


**Required Education and Experience**
-------------------------------------


* High School diploma or GED.
* 1 year of training experience or more.
* Experience writing training programs.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and Project.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Knowledge of training course design and implementation.
* Experience in presenting to small and large groups; experience in remote or web based presentations.
* Ability to work independently, resourcefully, to achieve tight deadlines and take initiative on multiple projects.
* Ability to handle a broad scope of responsibility, utilizing independent problem solving skills, strong project management, organizational and multitasking ability with clear prioritization.
* Adaptable \& enthusiastic team player.


**Preferred Education and Experience**
--------------------------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in business or related field.
* Project Management Certification.
* Multi\-lingual preferred (Hmong, Pashto, Persian/Dari, Urdu or Spanish)


**Working Conditions**
----------------------


* Occasional exposure to industrial operations including: temperature extremes from approximately 35ºF to 100ºF; noise levels in excess of 85 dB; moisture and moving machinery.


* Work is mainly performed in an office setting, with some time spent in a manufacturing environment


**EEOC \& Disclaimer**
----------------------

jobs.title: Implementation Program Manager
jobs.description:
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.


By combining comprehensive commerce\-enablement technology with high\-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator\-built software suite including OMS, Pre\- and Post\-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.


With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end\-to\-end commerce solutions combine best\-in\-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.


Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry\-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top\-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.


About the Role:
  

As an Implementation Program Manager you will be the face of Stord as we grow our
  

business and partnerships together with our customers. You will be responsible for driving the
  

onboarding experience of new customers to Stord's supply chain solutions, as well as enabling
  

the brand growth of existing customers as they launch new channels, services, and products to
  

their end\-customers.
**What You'll Do:*** Maintain and successfully execute a portfolio of customer projects ranging from

fulfillment onboarding to standalone (SW\-only) WMS \& OMS launches to Professional
* Services engagements; and gracefully and seamlessly adjust to rapidly changing

priorities in that portfolio
* Partner with Commercial, Implementation, Integration, and Operations team members to

drive and own all aspects of Stord’s onboarding process from signature through
  

hypercare, including systems, infrastructure, SOPs/training, testing, launch,
  

post\-deployment feedback, and translating customer enhancement requests to
  

requirements and SOPs
* Balance a number of internal and external priorities (i.e. customer business outcomes,

resource limitations, tight timelines, evolving scope changes, milestone risks and project
  

budget constraints) with discretion and thoughtfulness towards both customer and Stord
  

goals
* Track progress and performance in customer onboarding process (meeting

timelines/scope commitments, delivering revenue), including identifying and
  

implementing new KPIs and metrics to measure and improve our existing processes
* Spearhead the design and execution of innovative technology solutions and

implementation of new systems/processes for existing customers across our supply
  

chain network, such as the deployment of new internal tools for employee use, or
  

migrating customers from legacy systems to Stord software
* Provide feedback to refine, develop and evolve Stord’s service offering, solution design

process, and onboarding process and experience for new customers
* Act as a culture warrior for Stord values, as well as an advocate for continuous

improvement, by identifying opportunities and efficiencies in Supply Chain and across
  

the organization
**What You'll Need:*** Excellent communication skills (verbal, written), to communicate horizontally and

vertically within the organization and externally to customer stakeholders, all with clarity,
  

precision and succinctness
* Willingness to be a versatile team player that is comfortable under pressure, bold in

asking for clarification when the requirement or action item is unclear, and unafraid to
  

challenge assumptions or expectations that are unfounded
* The endless drive and resilience to remove barriers and enable teams to complete their

objectives, and the charisma to lead and bring together members from functional,
  

technical and operational to achieve program goals
* Experience in a cross\-functional, customer\-oriented change role such as a consultant,

manager, or customer implementation manager in a supply chain services, SaaS, and/or
  

consulting environment
* Demonstrated ability to deliver results in a complex, fast\-paced environment while

balancing multiple priorities, mitigating risks, and effectively managing limited resources
* Enthusiastic desire to continuously iterate and improve existing tools and processes,

with customer obsession and successful business outcomes as core drivers
* Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% for customer\-critical milestones such as

kickoffs and go\-lives; building strong customer relationships and leveraging effective
  

partnership across local \& remote Stord teams will be critical to your success in this role
**Strongly Encouraged:*** Supply Chain or Logistics experience – in particular in implementing WMS, OMS, SaaS

and/or fulfillment solutions
* Functional and/or technical solution design experience
* Transformation experience – including business process change management and

experience sunsetting legacy systems

jobs.title: Clinical Training Specialist
jobs.description:
HistoSonics is a commercial\-stage medtech company advancing the Edison® System, a novel non\-invasive sonic beam therapy based on histotripsy. Since receiving FDA De Novo grant for the non\-invasive destruction of liver tumors in 2023, the company has progressed beyond initial market entry into commercial expansion, reimbursement momentum, and ongoing clinical and pipeline development. In addition to its current liver tumor indication, HistoSonics is pursuing future indications across multiple applications including kidney, pancreas, prostate, neuro, women’s health, and other significant underserved human health areas, to realize the broader potential histotripsy across multiple disease states and medical specialties.


We offer an exciting work culture where cutting\-edge science meets real\-world application, and each team member’s contribution is important to our success in ensuring our physicians and their patients get what they need most.

**Location:** Hybrid \- Plymouth, MN

**Travel Requirement:** Up to 25% travel

**Position Summary (Why this role matters):**


The Clinical Training Specialist is responsible for delivering and executing HistoSonics' standardized onboarding program for Clinical Regional Managers, Account Managers, Clinical Specialists, and Procedural Development Specialists. This role serves as the primary instructor for new hire training, leading Foundations and Advanced Training while delivering classroom education, hands\-on simulation, product training, and competency\-based learning experiences that prepare employees for successful field immersion.


Working closely with the Clinical Training Manager and cross\-functional partners, the Clinical Training Specialist ensures a consistent, scalable, and high\-quality onboarding experience by delivering standardized curriculum, evaluating learner progress, and preparing new hires for transition into the field development phase of onboarding. This position plays a critical role in accelerating new hire readiness, improving competency development, and supporting organizational growth as new products, software enhancements, and clinical indications are introduced.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**New Hire Onboarding and Training Delivery**

* Deliver the classroom\-based portion of the organization's standardized 12\-week onboarding program by leading Foundations and Advanced Training, facilitating instructor\-led education, assessing knowledge progression, and preparing new hires for successful field immersion.
* Facilitate engaging instructor\-led classroom sessions, virtual training, hands\-on workshops, simulation\-based learning, and skills laboratories.
* Deliver education on disease states, anatomy, histotripsy technology, mechanism of action, product knowledge, procedural workflow, Edison System operation, and customer engagement best practices.
* Reinforce standardized clinical workflows, organizational processes, and customer engagement expectations throughout onboarding.
* Evaluate learner progress through written assessments, practical demonstrations, competency checklists, and knowledge validation activities.
* Provide individualized coaching and developmental feedback to prepare learners for successful field immersion and continued competency development.
* Ensure all onboarding milestones, training records, competency documentation, and Learning Management System (LMS) requirements are completed accurately and on schedule.
* Deliver education related to product enhancements, software releases, new clinical indications, and evolving clinical best practices to maintain organizational readiness.

**Training Program Support:**

* Collaborate with the Clinical Training Manager to continuously improve onboarding curriculum, instructional materials, and training effectiveness.
* Assist in developing presentations, facilitator guides, simulation exercises, job aids, and digital learning resources.
* Support updates to training content as new software releases, products, clinical evidence, and business initiatives are introduced.
* Maintain standardized training materials and ensure consistency across all onboarding cohorts.
* Assist in measuring onboarding effectiveness through learner feedback, assessments, and performance metrics.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Clinical Applications, Medical Affairs, Commercial, Marketing, and Product Development to ensure training content remains current and aligned with organizational objectives.
* Support the coordination and logistics of onboarding events, training labs, and internal education programs.

**Position Qualifications and Skills:**

* Bachelor's degree required, preferably in a clinical discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
* 3\+ years of experience in clinical applications, clinical education, medical affairs, or post\-market clinical support within medical devices or interventional medicine, or equivalent hands\-on experience supporting the HistoSonics Edison System.
* Strong understanding of image\-guided procedures, treatment workflow and physician training models.
* Demonstrated ability to interpret clinical data, evaluate safety trends and communicate complex clinical concepts clearly.
* Proven ability to collaborate across cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent communication skills, including translating clinical evidence into field\-ready guidance.
* Ability to travel 25%
**Preferred**

* Experience with Class II or III medical devices.
* Experience of collaborating with medical affairs, field clinical teams and clinical workflow experts.

 **Benefits:** We offer a comprehensive benefits package for full\-time employees. This includes health, dental, and vision insurance, life, short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, 401(k), paid time off, and more.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.


U.S. Work Authorization \& Sponsorship: Employer will not sponsor visas for position.

jobs.title: Sr. Clinical Training Specialist

HistoSonics is a commercial\-stage medtech company advancing the Edison® System, a novel non\-invasive sonic beam therapy based on histotripsy. Since receiving FDA De Novo grant for the non\-invasive destruction of liver tumors in 2023, the company has progressed beyond initial market entry into commercial expansion, reimbursement momentum, and ongoing clinical and pipeline development. In addition to its current liver tumor indication, HistoSonics is pursuing future indications across multiple applications including kidney, pancreas, prostate, neuro, women’s health, and other significant underserved human health areas, to realize the broader potential histotripsy across multiple disease states and medical specialties.


We offer an exciting work culture where cutting\-edge science meets real\-world application, and each team member’s contribution is important to our success in ensuring our physicians and their patients get what they need most.

**Location:** Hybrid \- Plymouth, MN

**Travel Requirement:** Up to 25% travel with overnight stays required.

**Position Summary (Why this role matters):**


The Senior Clinical Training Specialist is responsible for delivering, executing, and advancing HistoSonics’ standardized onboarding and clinical training programs for Clinical Regional Managers, Account Managers, Clinical Specialists, Procedural Development Specialists, and other designated field\-based roles. This position serves as a senior instructor and subject\-matter resource within the Clinical Training team, leading Foundations and Advanced Training while delivering classroom education, hands\-on simulation, product training, and competency\-based learning experiences that prepare employees for successful field immersion.


Working closely with the Clinical Training Manager and cross\-functional partners, the Senior Clinical Training Specialist ensures consistent, scalable, and high\-quality onboarding experience by delivering standardized curriculum, evaluating learner progress, identifying development needs, and preparing new hires for transition into the field development phase of onboarding.


In addition to training delivery, the Senior Clinical Training Specialist plays a key role in advancing the effectiveness and scalability of the training program. This includes contributing to curriculum development, mentoring and supporting Clinical Training Specialists, identifying opportunities to improve instructional methods, and supporting the integration of new products, software enhancements, clinical indications, and evolving clinical practices into training programs.


This position requires a highly experienced clinical educator who can independently facilitate complex clinical and technical education, adapt instruction to diverse learner needs, and serve as a trusted resource across the Clinical Training organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**New Hire Onboarding and Training Delivery**

* Lead the classroom\-based portion of the organization’s standardized 12\-week onboarding program, including Foundations and Advanced Training, by facilitating instructor\-led education, assessing knowledge progression, and preparing new hires for successful field immersion.
* Independently facilitate engaging instructor\-led classroom sessions, virtual training, hands\-on workshops, simulation\-based learning, and skills laboratories.
* Deliver advanced education on disease states, anatomy, histotripsy technology, mechanism of action, product knowledge, procedural workflows, Edison System operation, and customer engagement best practices.
* Reinforce standardized clinical workflows, organizational processes, clinical expectations, and customer engagement standards throughout onboarding.
* Evaluate learner progress through written assessments, practical demonstrations, competency checklists, simulation activities, and knowledge validation.
* Identify individual learner development needs and provide targeted coaching, feedback, and remediation strategies to support readiness for field immersion.
* Partner with Clinical Applications and field leadership to support effective learner transition from formal training into field\-based development.
* Ensure onboarding milestones, training records, competency documentation, and Learning Management System (LMS) requirements are completed accurately and on schedule.
* Deliver education related to product enhancements, software releases, new clinical indications, and evolving clinical and technical best practices to maintain organizational readiness.

**Training Program Development and Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with the Clinical Training Manager to continuously evaluate and improve onboarding curriculum, instructional methodology, training materials, and overall program effectiveness.
* Take a lead role in developing and updating presentations, facilitator guides, simulation exercises, competency assessments, job aids, case\-based learning activities, and digital learning resources.
* Translate complex clinical, technical, and procedural information into effective learner\-centered educational experiences.
* Support the integration of new software releases, products, clinical evidence, procedural workflows, and business initiatives into standardized training programs.
* Identify gaps in existing training programs and recommend solutions to improve learner readiness, consistency, and scalability.
* Maintain standardized training materials and ensure consistency in content delivery and learner expectations across onboarding cohorts.
* Support the development and implementation of new training methodologies, simulation strategies, and competency\-based education approaches.
* Assist in measuring training effectiveness through learner feedback, assessment performance, competency outcomes, and other program metrics.

**Trainer Development and Mentorship**

* Serve as a senior instructional resource and mentor to Clinical Training Specialists and other internal subject\-matter experts participating in training programs.
* Support the onboarding and development of new Clinical Training Specialists, including facilitation coaching, content preparation, and instructional best practices.
* Observe training delivery and provide constructive feedback to support consistency and continued development across the training team.
* Model effective adult\-learning principles, facilitation techniques, learner engagement strategies, and competency\-based education.
* Support trainer readiness and certification initiatives to expand organizational training capacity.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Clinical Applications, Medical Affairs, Commercial, Marketing, Product Development, and other cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure training content remains clinically accurate, technically current, and aligned with organizational objectives.
* Serve as a Clinical Training subject\-matter resource during the development and implementation of new products, software enhancements, clinical indications, and procedural workflows.
* Collaborate with internal clinical and technical subject\-matter experts to translate emerging knowledge into standardized training content.
* Support the coordination and execution of onboarding events, training laboratories, internal education programs, and other clinical training initiatives.

**Position Qualifications and Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in a clinical, healthcare, education, or related discipline.
* Minimum 7–10 years of progressive experience in a clinical training, clinical education, medical device education, clinical applications, or comparable training\-based role.
* Demonstrated experience independently delivering complex clinical, technical, or medical device education to healthcare professionals or field\-based employees.
* Demonstrated experience developing, implementing, or significantly improving clinical training programs, curricula, or competency\-based education.
* Strong understanding of adult\-learning principles, instructional methodologies, competency assessment, and learner\-centered education.
* Strong understanding of image\-guided procedures, clinical workflows, treatment workflows, and physician or healthcare professional training models.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex clinical and technical concepts into clear, practical, and effective educational content.
* Demonstrated ability to assess learner performance, identify development gaps, and provide effective coaching and remediation.
* Proven ability to collaborate and influence across cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple training priorities in a fast\-paced and rapidly evolving environment.
* Ability to travel approximately 25%.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Class II or Class III medical devices.
* Experience developing or leading clinical training programs within interventional medicine, medical imaging, robotics, or other complex medical technologies.
* Experience mentoring, precepting, or developing other clinical educators or trainers.
* Experience with simulation\-based education and competency\-based learning.
* Experience working collaboratively with Medical Affairs, Clinical Applications, field clinical teams, Product Development, and clinical workflow experts.
* Experience supporting organizational readiness for new products, software releases, technologies, or clinical indications.

jobs.title: Clinical Systems Specialist, Praxis Health
jobs.description:
We're looking for a **Clinical Systems Specialist** to handle the day to day technical and operational work that keeps the technology across Praxis Health clinics running for providers and clinic staff, the EHR and the systems around it: user account provisioning, EPCS, provider schedule updates, and troubleshooting. This is hands on, execution focused work, not project management or training.



The role also owns day to day coordination of the Oracle relationship as it relates to new products, system updates, and Service Request (SR) creation and management. This role is responsible for managing the operational coordination required to support the Oracle relationship, ensuring smooth, effective interaction and alignment with strategic initiatives.



The role reports to the Clinical Systems Manager and coordinates with Directors of Operations and RLCMs when an issue affects a specific clinic or provider, and works closely with Operations to define and maintain clinical workflows and workflow changes driven by Oracle updates.


**Location \& Schedule**


* **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
* **Location:** Remote for Oregon and Washington residents only

jobs.title: Manager, Implementations
jobs.description:
ClassWallet, a leading financial technology company in the United States serving agencies delegated responsibility to manage public funds, is seeking to hire a Manager, Implementations to join our team.


Agencies use ClassWallet to get public funds to the right people, and ensure the funds are used for the right purpose. ClassWallet's suite of products and services empowers agency administrators to dramatically increase efficiency of funds distribution and spend compliance, reduce programmatic costs, maximize the full potential impact of the program, and satisfy the needs and expectations of policymakers, constituents and public reporting. ClassWallet has processed over $6\.7 billion to date and serves public agencies across 39 states. In its 11\+ years in operation, ClassWallet has completed over 12M transactions, funded 1\.1M recipients, processed over 5M applications, and now serves 300\+ state and local agency clients, supported by a team of 280\+ full\-time staff.


The Company has developed an industry\-defining digital wallet solution which has gained rapid traction among state and local agencies and school districts across America. ClassWallet ranks as the 61st fastest growing software company on the prestigious Inc. 5000 list of fastest\-growing private companies and the 21st fastest growing financial technology company on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 in 2023\.

As a result of ClassWallet’s innovation, public programs run with exponentially more efficiency and the impact and breadth of the programs for the individuals they serve is dramatically higher. jobs.title: Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist
jobs.description:
Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist Position Overview

Charm Experts is seeking a senior, client\-facing **Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist** to lead the setup, implementation, training, and ongoing optimization of CharmHealth EHR accounts for medical practices.

This position requires more than general familiarity with the platform. The successful candidate will take ownership of implementations following the initial sale, assess each practice’s clinical and administrative needs, translate those requirements into an effective CharmHealth configuration, and guide the client from discovery through go\-live and post\-launch stabilization.

Our clients range from solo providers launching new practices to established, multi\-provider organizations migrating from other EHR platforms or seeking to improve their existing CharmHealth environment.

Position Type

This position will initially be structured as a part\-time independent contractor engagement, with the potential to transition into full\-time employment based on performance, client demand, and company growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead client discovery, kickoff, implementation, and workflow\-planning meetings.
* Evaluate each practice’s clinical, administrative, scheduling, billing, and patient\-engagement requirements.
* Develop tailored implementation plans, timelines, and task lists.
* Configure new and existing CharmHealth accounts, including:
* Practice, facility, provider, and staff settings
* Roles, permissions, and user access
* Appointment types, scheduling rules, and provider calendars
* Clinical workflows and encounter settings
* Custom charting and specialty\-specific clinical templates
* Intake forms, questionnaires, consent forms, and patient communications
* Patient portal registration and workflows
* Telehealth services
* E\-prescribing and EPCS coordination
* Laboratory and imaging integrations
* Diagnosis, procedure, medication, and laboratory preference lists
* Billing, coding, payment, and clearinghouse workflows
* Support patient\-data migration and validate the accuracy and completeness of imported records.
* Coordinate third\-party integrations and communicate with CharmHealth, clearinghouses, laboratories, pharmacies, and other vendors as needed.
* Train providers, practice administrators, clinical staff, and front\-office personnel.
* Create written implementation documentation, workflow guides, and training materials.
* Manage multiple client projects, priorities, deadlines, and deliverables simultaneously.
* Provide go\-live support, troubleshooting, and post\-launch stabilization.
* Conduct post\-implementation reviews and recommend improvements to workflows, templates, reporting, and system utilization.
* Maintain clear, timely, and professional communication with clients throughout each engagement.
* Identify opportunities for workflow automation, API integrations, analytics, and continued account optimization.

Required Qualifications

* Five or more years of EHR implementation, configuration, onboarding, or optimization experience.
* Substantial direct, hands\-on experience with the CharmHealth EHR and practice\-management platform.
* Demonstrated ability to configure CharmHealth accounts for real\-world medical\-practice operations.
* Experience translating clinical and administrative workflows into efficient system configurations.
* Strong understanding of medical\-practice operations, including scheduling, documentation, patient intake, prescribing, laboratory workflows, billing, and revenue\-cycle processes.
* Experience developing clinical templates, intake forms, questionnaires, consent forms, and standardized workflows.
* Experience training clinical and nonclinical users with varying levels of technical proficiency.
* Strong project\-management, organizational, documentation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent client\-facing communication and consultative skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and take ownership of projects from discovery through stabilization.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA requirements and the proper handling of protected health information.

Strongly Preferred

* Approximately five years of direct CharmHealth implementation and optimization experience.
* Experience implementing CharmHealth across multiple specialties or practice types.
* Experience working with solo providers, startup practices, telehealth organizations, and multi\-provider medical groups.
* Experience with patient\-data migration and EHR transition projects.
* Knowledge of CharmHealth billing, eClaims, clearinghouse, and revenue\-cycle workflows.
* Familiarity with CharmHealth APIs and third\-party integrations.
* Experience with workflow\-automation and analytics platforms such as Zoho, n8n, or comparable systems.
* Experience developing reusable implementation standards, checklists, training programs, and account\-optimization plans.

What Success Looks Like

The successful specialist will be able to take a new client from an initial requirements discussion to a properly configured, documented, and stable CharmHealth environment. Providers and staff should be prepared to use the system confidently at go\-live, with efficient workflows supporting patient care, practice operations, billing, compliance, and future growth.

To Apply

Please provide:

* A résumé or summary of your relevant professional experience
* A two\- to three\-minute video introducing yourself and describing your experience working with CharmHealth
* The number of years you have worked directly with CharmHealth
* Examples of CharmHealth implementations, configurations, or optimization projects you have completed
* The types and sizes of medical practices you have supported
* Examples of clinical templates, forms, workflows, integrations, or training programs you have developed
* Your availability and preferred engagement structure
* Your hourly rate or compensation requirements

Pay: $67,964\.52 \- $81,849\.74 per year

Work Location: Remote

**Implementation Consultant – AI Service Applications**  

Department: Professional Services
Reports To: Senior Director, Professional Services
Employment Type: Full\-Time **ABOUT US**  

We are dealer focused and OEM aligned. We are a leading ERP \& DMS software and solutions provider to dealers and rental companies of heavy equipment. We specialize in working with the construction, mining, forestry, material handling, and agriculture industries. Today, we have over 800 employees, offices on four continents, and customers in over 20 countries. We are privately held, and our headquarters are in beautiful Cary, NC. We are actively seeking talented individuals to join our team and help us aggressively grow our international \& North American footprint for both our 100% cloud\-based ERP, DMS, and Rental solutions. **WHY WORK FOR VITALEDGE**  

We don't just sell technology, we enable transformation that results in broader societal benefits like building homes and critical infrastructure, growing food and delivering all sorts of products we all rely on for daily life. We exist to ultimately equip the world to keep running. We have more than 60 years of combined experience and three industry\-leading software suites and associated apps, with which we will drive the market forward. It's an exciting time to work for VitalEdge, join us! **POSITION OVERVIEW**  

We are looking for a hybrid technical and functional specialist to lead the implementation and ongoing management of our new AI Technician Assist platform. The platform analyzes historical service data, repair patterns, failure codes, and OEM resources to help field and shop technicians reach a faster, more accurate diagnosis of a customer\-reported machine failure.
The role sits at the intersection of AI technology, our e\-Emphasys ERP service data, and real\-world equipment service operations. The ideal candidate can speak credibly with an AI product team, read our ERP service data structures, and just as importantly, understand how a technician actually works through a failure in the field. **RESPONSIBILITIES**  

Solution Implementation: Lead the end\-to\-end implementation of the AI Technician Assist platform, covering configuration, data integration, pilot rollout, and scaling across service centers, partnering with IT, Service Operations, and the e\-Emphasys ERP Product team.
